n999e9315c6.headline: UK Gilt Yields Fall on Rising Expectations of a BOE Rate Pause
n999e9315c6.summary: UK gilt yields fell as markets increasingly expected the Bank of England to pause interest rate rises. The expectation follows Wednesday's policy decision.
n999e9315c6.why: Gilts are UK government bonds, and their yields move with expectations for Bank of England policy rates, which affect borrowing costs across the economy.
n999e9315c6.why_moved: Markets increasingly expect the Bank of England to pause rate rises after its Wednesday decision, which lowers expected policy rates and pushes gilt yields down as bond prices rise.
